hero.title: Relax Apartments
hero.subtitle: Enjoy your stay in Stolac, Bosnia and Herzegovina!
hero.description: Relax Apartments offers two comfortable and modern apartments with a spacious terrace, private parking, and a rose-filled garden. Ideally located in the city center, perfect for exploring Herzegovina and relaxing in a peaceful setting with views of the Old Town fortress.

groundLevel.title: Ground Level Apartment (2 bedrooms)
groundLevel.description: Nestled on the ground floor, this cozy apartment boasts views of our lush garden filled with vibrant roses. Enjoy the private patio surrounded by fragrant blooms after a day of exploring the city. Located in the city of Stolac, our spot offers easy access to attractions. Enjoy a hassle-free stay with our free private parking.

rooms.5: Air conditioning, WiFi, TV, washing machine

upperLevel.title: Upper Level Apartment (3 bedrooms)
upperLevel.description: Situated on the upper floor, this bright and comfortable apartment offers peace and privacy in a quiet neighborhood with friendly locals. It features a private parking spot, a large balcony ideal for relaxing, and stunning views of the surrounding hills and gardens. The interior includes a fully equipped kitchen, a cozy living area, and multiple sleeping arrangements perfect for families or groups.

rooms.5: Air conditioning, WiFi, TV, washing machine

location.title: Location
location.description: We are located in a quiet area, just a 3-minute walk from the city center. Perfect for relaxing, yet close to everything you need!

reviews.title: Reviews
reviews.description: What our guests say about us

list.name: Deborah
list.comment: Liked everything, hosts were amazing, beds comfortable and great location. If you are looking to book a place in Stolac, make it here :)

list.name: Dainoras
list.comment: The hosts are super kind and the location is not too far from Mostar, the rooms are perfect, highly recommend, especially if you are with a larger group

list.name: Belma
list.comment: Ideal location for Stolac, very friendly hosts, air-conditioned, washing machine, there was even coffee, shamp... We were sorry to leave the apartment after 3 nights. By the way, we kayaked on Bregava, passed the Istup canyon, visited the fortress above the town and sights in the town itself, Daorson, the old church... Everything really beautiful.

list.name: Mehmed
list.comment: Everything was good.I really was satisfied.

list.name: Jane
list.comment: This was such a wonderfully suited place to enjoy the area. Everything was clean and comfortable- we loved it!

list.name: Marko
list.comment: Friendly hosts, a good location, clean and a good value for money.

list.name: Julia
list.comment: Everything was perfect. Very clean apartments, covered terraces with a view of the mountains. Kitchen utensils provided and close to the town center. Perfect for a family stay.

list.name: Dagmara
list.comment: Very nice, helpful host, perfectly clean and well-equipped new apartment. Safe parking on the premises. Very nice area, nearby atmospheric pub with traditional food at affordable prices.

list.question: What is the check-in and check-out time?
list.answer: The check-in time is from 1:00 PM, and the check-out time is until 10:30 AM. Flexible by arrangement if possible.

list.question: Is there a parking space?
list.answer: Yes, there is a free private parking space for each apartment.

list.question: Is there a washing machine?
list.answer: Yes, both apartments have a washing machine.

list.question: Is there WiFi and air conditioning?
list.answer: Yes, both apartments have free WiFi and air conditioning.
